summary: Check that an administrator is signed in

200.description: The session belongs to an administrator; the answer has no body

description:
nginx asks this before it serves an admin page (the `auth_request` directive) and shows the page only when the answer is 200. The answer has no body: 200 for a signed-in administrator, 401 without a valid session, 403 for an API token or a user who is not an administrator. Scripts have no use for it.

Needs: a signed-in session of an administrator (API tokens are refused)
